mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ai_periodic_summary ( summary_type, period_start, period_end, stats_json, llm_summary, created_at ) VALUES ( #{summaryType}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, CAST(#{statsJson} AS JSON), #{llmSummary}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, summary_type, period_start, period_end, stats_json, llm_summary, created_at FROM ai_periodic_summary WHERE summary_type = #{summaryType} ORDER BY period_end DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
